title: Understanding the 4 Drivers of Bitcoin’s Price
content:
Bitcoin’s adoption growth mirrors other phenomenon in nature such as the spread of a virus, the value of a social network, and the adoption of the internet itself. I firmly believe bitcoin will grow over time, and the Power Law and bitcoin’s similarities to gold combine to underpin the reason for everyone to own bitcoin in their portfolio. You simply can’t afford to miss the adoption wave of the next gold, a monetary asset with 5,000 years of history. [...] As bitcoin grows older, its adoption and price both rise. This statement is not some revelation, but brilliant physicists have shown us that, despite enormous swings, bitcoin’s price follows a model price that helps anchor our expectations. For example, today’s expected price is around $127,000, which rises above $200,000 in only a couple years.

Link to chart [...] TBL’s four drivers are the result of all that research, book writing, classroom teaching, market commentating, and, frankly, trading bitcoin. If you’ve been reading at a distance, visiting TBL Pulse, or watching our shows, they might already be familiar to you, but my goal today is to help everyone simplify what moves bitcoin in their minds.
